notes.title: 🛠️ Optimisation Patch – Getting Things in Shape
notes.notes:
Hi there!

After receiving a bug report (thank you!), we discovered that our game wasn’t as optimized as it should’ve been. So we rolled up our sleeves and got to work.

This was a necessary fix that touched some core parts of the game. As a result:

 The build size is much smaller now
 The game runs more smoothly – no more freezing on Steam Deck!
 Performance is improved, with lower resource usage across the board

With these issues out of the way, we can finally move forward with something we've promised before: proper gamepad support is up next 🎮

Important:
We recommend uninstalling the game and installing it again instead of just downloading the update. This helps make sure no old files get in the way of the improved build.

If you run into any issues, have suggestions, or just want to say hi, you can always reach us at hello@possumriot.com.

Thanks for sticking with us 💛

Possum Riot Team
